content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the structure of a bacterial cell
Explain the differences between prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells
Compare bacterial cells with animal and plant cells

Bacteria are single-celled microorganisms that have existed on Earth for over 3.5 billion years. They are found everywhere - in soil, water, air, and inside living organisms. Despite their tiny size (typically 1-5 μm), bacteria are incredibly successful and diverse.
